# Παρουσίαση αρχικών δεδομένων

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
xx <- rnorm(1000, mean =4, sd=1)
myDatax <- data.frame(xx= xx)
```

```{r}
#| echo = F,
#| results = "asis",
#| message = FALSE
knitr::kable(head(myDatax, n=100)) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F) %>%
scroll_box(width = "max-content", height = "200px")
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
if(!require(ggplot2)){
    install.packages("ggplot2")
    library(ggplot2)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
dataPlot <- ggplot(myDatax, aes(x="", y=xx))
dataPlot +  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(shape=16, size=1,position=position_jitter(0.2))
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
dataPloth <- ggplot(myDatax, aes(x=xx))
dataPloth +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.6, fill = "green")
```

# Προσθέσεις - αφαιρέσεις

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Προσθέσεις

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
xSYN3 <- xx+3
myDataxSYN3 <- data.frame(x= xx, xSYN3=xSYN3)
myDataxSYN3w <- stack(myDataxSYN3, select=c("x", "xSYN3"))
```

```{r}
#| echo = F,
#| results = "asis",
#| message = FALSE
knitr::kable(head(myDataxSYN3, n=100)) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F) %>%
scroll_box(width = "max-content", height = "200px")
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
dataPlot <- ggplot(myDataxSYN3w, aes(x=ind, y=values, color=ind))
dataPlot + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(shape=16, size=1,position=position_jitter(0.2))
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE,
#| message= FALSE
dataPloth <- ggplot(myDataxSYN3w, aes(x=values, fill=ind))
dataPloth +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1, position = "identity", alpha = 0)
```

## Αφαιρέσεις

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
xPLIN1 <- xx-1
myDataxPLIN1 <- data.frame(x= xx, xPLIN1=xPLIN1)
myDataxPLIN1w <- stack(myDataxPLIN1, select=c("x", "xPLIN1"))
```

```{r}
#| echo = F,
#| results = "asis",
#| message = FALSE
knitr::kable(head(myDataxPLIN1, n=100)) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F) %>%
scroll_box(width = "max-content", height = "200px")
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE
dataPlot <- ggplot(myDataxPLIN1w, aes(x=ind, y=values, color=ind))
dataPlot + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(shape=16, size=1,position=position_jitter(0.2))
```

```{r}
#| echo = FALSE,
#| message= FALSE
dataPloth <- ggplot(myDataxPLIN1w, aes(x=values, fill=ind))
dataPloth +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1, position = "identity", alpha = 0)
```

:::

# Πολλαπλασιασμοί - διαιρέσεις

::: {.panel-tabset}
